target: acceptance 1 — an invalid value must mark the spec `blocked`, not merely skip it. A skipped spec is retried silently every night forever; a blocked one is seen.
cmd: mkdir -p s; cp "$FIXTURES/profile/banana.md" s/903-bad.md; cp "$FIXTURES/profile/standard.md" s/904-ok.md; out=$(FACTORY_SPECS_DIR="$PWD/s" "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh" claim specd building t 2>/dev/null); bad=$(grep -m1 "^status:" s/903-bad.md | sed "s/status: //"); ok=$(grep -m1 "^status:" s/904-ok.md | sed "s/status: //"); printf '{"bad":"%s","ok":"%s","claimed":"%s"}' "$bad" "$ok" "$(basename "$out")"
